name: add_node
description: Add a node to an existing scene

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the scene file (relative to project)

parentNodePath.description: Path to the parent node (e.g., "root" or "root/Player")

nodeType.description: Type of node to add (e.g., Sprite2D, CollisionShape2D)

properties.description: Optional properties to set on the node
